{{Quote|I was walking home and one of Lady Valarian's guards (if you can call that scum 'guards') called out to some Hutt hirelings something about how Lady Valarian was going to be the top power in Mos Eisley and opened fire on them. '''Escara Frei''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need you to take care of a couple of patients that got caught in a territory war in Mos Eisley.|[[2-1b-58|Billingsly]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:CitC" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Escara Frei resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The woman was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sympathizer and was a friend of Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jasha]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]].<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Frei and a man named [[Jorund Redd]] was caught in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] between [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|guards]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|thugs]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The old woman was hit by one or more shots, but her injuries weren't severe. A [[Medic/Legends|medic]], sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] to help [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Nillika]] and the local medical staff, treated her wounds. Frei suggested that the medic may contact Captain Jasha to work for the Empire.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

Later the same year, she visited the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Mos Eisley [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]] to complain about noise caused by unscrupulous [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]].<ref name="KtP">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67406&month=082007|text=Friday Feature – Keeping the Peace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Escara Frei was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CitC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Escara Frei was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Escara Frei could be found near the starport and medical center in Mos Eisley. She was part of the low-level quest "[[W:c:swg:Caught in the Crossfire|Caught in the Crossfire]]" for players of the [[W:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]]. The player was contacted by Billingsly and needed to talk to Frei to treat her wounds.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />
